text:
Jules (Docs): Morning — staging deploy tomorrow. Need final sign-off on the changelog entry for embeddings consolidation + rollback note. Keep it brief and copy-ready for marketing.
Priya (PM): Single-sentence customer line: 'Embeddings API consolidated for consistent latency; migrate to /api/embeddings with model_id by 2026-05-10.' PM wants the date included.
Omar (SDK): Snippets: Node/Python already updated in PR 4302. Go still uses old import path and payload key 'model' in one example. I'll push a small change.
Jules (Docs): Can you paste the exact Go diff you'll push so I can update the docs code block?
Omar (SDK): Old Go payload: fmt.Sprintf(`{"model":"embed-x","input":"%s"}`, text)
New Go payload: fmt.Sprintf(`{"model_id":"embed-2026-small","input":"%s"}`, text)
Also import path: "github.com/redwood/sdk" -> "github.com/redwood/inference-go/sdk"
Jules (Docs): Thanks. I'll swap both in the Go snippet.
Ravi (I18n): I need the source strings for the announcement and the known-issue blurb in key/value format. Prefer short strings (max 120 chars) for translator sanity.
Jules (Docs): Source string 1: changelog.embeds.announce = "Embeddings API consolidated; migrate to /api/embeddings with model_id by 2026-05-10."
Source string 2: changelog.embeds.known_issue = "Some legacy clients sending 'model' may receive 400s; use migration shim or update payloads."
Ravi (I18n): Got it. I'll queue FR/DE/JP. Note: DE should say "geplante Entfernung" not literal "deprecated".
ci-bot: docs-ci: linkcheck failed on branch release/embed-consolidation (1 failing redirect to /v1/embeddings)
Jules (Docs): Which files still reference /v1/embeddings?
ci-bot: Occurrences: docs/snippets/node/embeddings.md, docs/snippets/cli/quickstart.md, docs/faq/embeddings.md
Omar (SDK): I've opened PR 4310 to update the CLI and Node snippets. Will include migration shim example using X-Legacy-Model header.
Jules (Docs): Drafting migration shim snippet for docs: curl example with header X-Legacy-Model: true and new model_id payload. I'll paste in PR.
Priya (PM): Add a rollback sentence: if customers see >5% increase in errors after migration, request temporary aliasing by support; ops can restore alias for 48h while you update clients. Keep it concise.
Jules (Docs): Draft known-issue blurb added to changelog: "Intermittent 400s for clients sending model instead of model_id. Workaround: migration shim header or update payloads. Contact support for aliasing."
Ravi (I18n): Pushed FR/DE translations for the announcement. JP will follow in 20m.
ci-bot: docs-ci: build passed on branch release/embed-consolidation after fixes (linkcheck, snippet-tests) :white_check_mark:
Omar (SDK): Go fix merged. All snippet-tests green locally.
Jules (Docs): Final merge checklist: 1) confirm i18n strings (Ravi) 2) ensure all /v1/embeddings refs replaced (Jules) 3) merge PRs for snippets (Omar) 4) PM sign-off on customer line (Priya) 5) docs-ci green.
Priya (PM): Approved. Good to publish once ci-bot is green on main.
Jules (Docs): Publishing to staging now. Will ping marketing with the 1-line and a short internal rollback note linking to /ops/runbooks/changelog-rollback. Thanks team. :rocket:
